Class DefaultLogConfig

java.lang.Object
tij.jca.logging.DefaultLogConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
ILogConfig
public final class DefaultLogConfig extends Object implements ILogConfig
Default immutable implementation of ILogConfig.

instances of this class are created through the DefaultLogConfig.Builder, which provides sensible defaults for all configuration options.

The resulting configuration is immutable and can safely be shared between logger instances.
